modules.name: Larynx
modules.description: LF-glottis voice source (Fant-Liljencrants) with fold-length allometry, tension/pressure CV, and semi-coupled tract feedback

modules.name: Breath
modules.description: Respiratory pressure reservoir and physically-shaped envelope generator with energy-limited sustain and whale-style air retention mode

modules.name: Oral Chamber
modules.description: Kelly-Lochbaum waveguide vocal tract with tongue/velum/constriction CVs, variable tract length (species scaling), nasal branch, and audio injection position

modules.name: Voice
modules.description: Fused Larynx and Oral Chamber with internal semi-coupled feedback loop; exposes pre-tract source and both radiation outputs

modules.name: Heart
modules.description: Time-varying elastance cardiac pump: SA-node clock with pacer input, Wiggers-cycle envelopes, ECG/beat clocks, phonocardiogram sound, and mass allometry from shrew to elephant

modules.name: Broca
modules.description: Broca-Brika articulatory cortex and phoneme generator: vowel A/B morphing, 20 consonant manners (nasals, glides, fricatives, plosive stops), and polyphonic Tract/Larynx CV buses

modules.name: Visual1
modules.description: Audio-to-image visualizer: FFT band envelopes drive 8x8 DCT coefficients of a rendered image (mosaic/phase modes) or perturb a loaded JPEG's coefficients (perturb mode)
